##### Project general facts

The Harbour is a waterfront residential address on the marina, developed by Eagle Hills. The community is formed by two mirrored apartment buildings arranged around an infinity pool, overlooking the marina with its yacht berths and waterfront dining. The collection comprises one, two and three bedroom apartments, each designed with generous balconies or terraces that open the living spaces to marina views.

Residents enjoy an infinity pool, a gym, a private cinema room and a dedicated kids' club, complemented by a residents' lounge for relaxed gatherings. The wider marina adds a yacht club with berths and fuelling services, a beach club, curated retail and food and beverage outlets. Across the island, open green spaces, eco parks, picnic areas, cycling paths, jogging and walking tracks, sports facilities, children's play areas, schools, a nursery, mosques and community hubs support everyday family life.

Interiors follow a calm, contemporary palette with wood-effect flooring in living areas and bedrooms, marble finishes in the master bathroom and stained veneer doors and joinery. Kitchens feature engineered stone countertops and kitchen appliances, while air conditioning, water heaters, wardrobes and walk-in closets are included.

##### Location description and benefits

Ramhan Island is a private island destination in Abu Dhabi, set among turquoise lagoons, mangroves and secluded beaches close to the city's main leisure islands. It is connected to Sheikh Khalifa Bin Zayed Highway, which links the island with Saadiyat Island, Yas Island, Al Reem Island and the city centre, while preserving a calm, resort-style atmosphere surrounded by water and nature.

The highway gives quick access to Abu Dhabi International Airport, the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and the cultural district of Saadiyat Island with the Louvre Abu Dhabi and leading international schools. Yas Island offers theme parks, Yas Marina Circuit, Yas Mall and championship golf, while Al Maryah Island and the central business district concentrate offices, healthcare and premium shopping within a short drive.

Ramhan Island is master planned by Eagle Hills as a complete island community with villas, branded residences, a hotel and a marina, creating a lifestyle offer that is rare in the capital. Waterfront homes on the island appeal to end users seeking privacy close to the city and to investors targeting long-term and holiday rental demand, supported by Abu Dhabi's growing tourism, stable economy and investor-friendly ownership framework.
